capabilities: Plan story structure on a customizable plot grid with draggable scene cards
Build a searchable world codex of characters, places, factions, and objects
Draft chapters in typewriter mode with a prose coach and rearrangeable chapter panel
Visualize relationships, family trees, and timelines drawn from codex data
Export the finished manuscript as Word, EPUB, Markdown, or screenplay
extras: Work in progress per the README; free with no account and no network calls; includes an optional sample project (Saltmarch); requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later; manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author writes: "I built Plotverk for writers and creators like me who want powerful tools without a steep learning curve."
problem: Writing setups usually require installing and learning separate plugins for outlining, character tracking, word counts, and other story tools that do not work together.
summary: All-in-one novel-writing suite that plans stories on a plot grid, builds a world codex, maps relationships and timelines, and drafts chapters.
